about: three.js / Babylon / graphics-library mentions per file in packages/**; third-party runtime dependencies

history.reason: Initial baseline: what main held at 5c34c002 when the quality gate landed

New optional @margoengine/ui (queue item 20): widgets, layout, themes, input and the accessibility mirror. The text package is a required dependency (every widget draws text with it), so ui and ui/react count as leaks of it; ui/react also lists react as an optional peer.

The .babylon scene format loader and exporter (@margoengine/loaders/babylon, @margoengine/exporters/babylon) must name the format, its file extension and its customType values (BABYLON.StandardMaterial); no engine code is copied. Includes the generated umbrella and kit entries, and packages/selection/README.md (3 mentions, already on main before this commit)
